content.comment_body: Hello! I'm having issues with [product_name] V5 simulation mode—counters aren't functioning correctly. When I run the same program in [product_name] V4, it works fine and this is becoming quite frustrating. I've attached a sample program that works on V4 but not V5. Any help would be appreciated.

This issue should only occur within the software itself. If you test with actual [product_name] hardware, the program should operate as expected. For accurate simulation, try raising the off threshold to 1. It appears to be a bug in [product_name] V5.0. Perhaps a future software update will address this. I hope I’ve interpreted your issue correctly regarding the counter reset.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing malfunctioning counters in simulation mode on [product_name] V5, while the same logic works properly in V4. This points to a possible software bug or regression impacting simulation reliability. Users report frustration due to inconsistent behavior between versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect consistent counter behavior in simulation mode across different [product_name] versions, allowing for reliable testing and development.
